RFC8092-3-1.note: Forbidden behaviour: a speaker transmitting a LARGE_COMMUNITY attribute that carries the same 12-octet value twice. TestLargeCommunitiesWriteToNoDuplicates asserts n == 24 for a three-entry list holding one duplicate, so it goes red if LargeCommunities.WriteTo stops deduplicating; TestLargeCommunities (negative) pins that distinct values are all emitted. Only the WriteTo producer is covered: the adj-rib-out replay encoder in internal/component/bgp/plugins/rib/ribout_entry.go (parseLargeCommunityWire then appendAttr) re-encodes the stored value without deduplication, and forward-unchanged raw attribute bytes are not asserted either, so a duplicate can reach the wire on a path no tagged unit exercises.

RFC8092-3-2.note: Judge 2026-09-30 (R34, D-8 fixed). Producer reactor/rfc8092_large_community.go::removeRedundantLargeCommunities, called from publishBase: scan first (pairwise up to 16 values, seeded 64k-bit stack filter with exact confirm above), rebuild only on a repeat, keeping first occurrences in order, the peer's flags and header width, length rewritten, other attributes copied unchanged. Positive TestRFC8092RedundantLargeCommunityRemovedBeforePropagation: 2 copies (1-octet length) and 23 values with 3 repeats (extended length, filter path): no error, ActionNone, published and forwarded attribute hold each value once in first-occurrence order. Negative TestRFC8092DistinctLargeCommunitiesKeptWhole: 3 and 22 distinct values (filter path) published octet-equal to the received body and forwarded whole. Both have observed-red revert records. A non-multiple-of-12 value stays treat-as-withdraw (publishBase not reached). Attribute-package tags on ParseLargeCommunities remain unproven secondary units.

RFC8092-5-1.note: Forbidden behaviour: a canonical rendering with a leading zero (e.g. 065001) or a zero rendered as anything but a single 0 (00, empty). TestAppendText_LargeCommunityElement asserts exact strings: {0,0,0} -> 0:0:0 goes red on either zero-clause violation, and 65001:100:200 and the 4294967295 case go red on any padding. LargeCommunity.String derives from AppendText. Single-polarity marker present.

RFC8092-6-1.note: rejudge 2026-10-02 (c33 judge): {single-polarity: positive} is valid: the rule only forbids rejection and the validator has no Global Administrator path to refuse. TestRFC8092LargeCommunityAnyGlobalAdministratorIsWellFormed asserts RFC7606ActionNone through ValidateUpdateRFC7606 for reserved 0, 65535 and 4294967295, AS_TRANS 23456, documentation 64496, private 4200000000 and unallocated 1000000, each in a well-formed 12-octet value with ORIGIN, AS_PATH and NEXT_HOP present, so only the Global Administrator varies.

RFC8092-6-2.note: rejudge 2026-10-02 (c33 judge): both clauses, both polarities. + TestRFC8092LargeCommunityLengthNotANonZeroMultipleOf12IsMalformed: lengths 0, 1, 11, 13, 23, 25 each draw TreatAsWithdraw with AttrCode 32 (zero and non-multiple). - TestRFC8092LargeCommunityNonZeroMultipleOf12IsNotMalformed: 12, 24, 36 (distinct values) draw ActionNone. HEAD units kept (length 10 / length 12). Judge break: validator condition replaced by length%12 > 1 (accepts 0, 1, 13, 25) turns only the new + red; every HEAD unit stays green, which was the gap.

RFC8092-6-3.note: Independent supplemental source rejudgment, 2026-10-06. RFC8092 Section 6: "A BGP Large Communities attribute SHALL NOT be considered malformed due to presence of duplicate Large Community values." Read both tagged units: reactor TestRFC8092DuplicateLargeCommunityIsNotMalformed and attribute TestLargeCommunitiesDeduplication. The reactor supplies one complete 12-byte value twice in a properly bounded attribute and otherwise valid ORIGIN, ASN4 AS_SEQUENCE 65002 and NEXT_HOP; teValidationSession explicitly negotiates ASN4. It requires exact RFC7606ActionNone, no error and one retained LARGE_COMMUNITY attribute. The decoder carrier requires no error and the exact two distinct values from three inputs including one duplicate. These assertions fail duplicate-triggered reset, treat-as-withdraw or attribute discard without a neighboring malformed-length confound. Traced message validator registry code 32 -> validateLargeCommunityAttr (nonzero multiple-of-12 only), enforceRFC7606 ActionNone -> publishBase -> removeRedundantLargeCommunities, and session_read.go continues non-error actions to delivery rather than dropping them. ParseLargeCommunities independently returns its deduplicated values. The existing single-positive annotation correctly avoids demanding a conforming duplicate-based rejection; malformed length is a different requirement. Current moved unit changes empty AS_PATH/rfc7311EBGPSession to a matching valid AS_SEQUENCE/ASN4 teValidationSession: fixture isolation repair in the current patch, not an assertion weakening or mere line movement. This judgment does not rejudge RFC8092-3-2 or carry forward its old D-8 finding as if unchanged; that separate row is outside this assignment. Prior enforced verdict retained; no tests or mutations run and no new defect found.

RFC8092-6-4.note: Independent semantic rejudgment: RFC8092 Section 6: "A BGP UPDATE message with a malformed BGP Large Communities attribute SHALL be handled using the approach of "treat-as-withdraw" as described in Section 2 of [RFC7606]." Current TestRFC8092MalformedLargeCommunityWithdrawsTheRoutes asserts actual reactor handoff as withdrawn NLRI with no reachable NLRI/attributes, Established retained and no notification, paired with unchanged valid attribute/NLRI delivery. The caller-bypass mutation now fails that withdrawal oracle, not merely ValidateUpdateRFC7606 Action. The duplicate-values-as-malformed fault independently fails the valid duplicate carrier, providing legitimate admission discrimination; it does not create a new judgment for an unrequested duplicate requirement. Source and tagged consumers therefore protect the actual RFC7606 caller behavior, while unexecuted foreign FRR carriers remain pending. These are inspected scratch semantic executions, not canonical discrimination records. Current native record renewal/stamping remains parent-owned; no pending FRR carrier run, SRPM behavior, dataplane behavior, or full-RFC acceptance is inferred.
